# Known REAL photos (benchmark set)

Drop images here that you KNOW are real camera photos (your own phone
pictures are perfect — including WhatsApp-forwarded copies, since those
lose their EXIF and are the hard case). Used by

    cd backend && py -m eval.image_model_benchmark

to test which local detector model performs best. Any .png / .jpg /
.jpeg / .webp / .bmp file works.
